contract.goal: A structured markdown report that answers the question asked, where every figure, date and quote is cited to a source the crew read and appears in that source.

deliverables.description: The cited report: the answer up front, the findings with their evidence, what the evidence cannot show, and the sources it cites

criteria.text: The report is a full document organized under section headings
It lists the sources it cites in a Sources or References section
Its claims cite at least three sources, and every cited file exists
Every number, date and quote appears in the source it cites; nothing checkable is stated that no source shows
It says what the evidence cannot show

checks.label: a statement of what the evidence cannot show

criteria.text: It answers the question it was asked in its opening section, for the audience named

judge.rubric: Does the report answer the question it was asked in its opening section, in terms the named audience can act on?
